identity.description: Original single-seat, low-wing aerobatic trainer with a steerable tailwheel and fixed-pitch propeller.
identity.author: FlightCraft contributors

prop_ct.source: Original fixed-pitch blade-element design estimate: CT=T/(rho*n^2*D^4). Static CT=0.115 selected for a lightly loaded two-blade 1.85 m propeller; linear unloading to zero at J=1.2 with bounded negative windmill thrust. Paired with CP to keep propulsive efficiency J*CT/CP below 0.85; no real propeller data.

prop_cp.source: Original blade-element power estimate: CP=P/(rho*n^3*D^5). Static CP=0.060 absorbs about 150 kW near 2700 rpm; pitch unloading reduces CP with advance ratio. At J=0.6 efficiency is 0.833, and at J=0.9 it is 0.746; piecewise values are original design assumptions.

power_density.source: Original ideal normally aspirated piston-engine estimate: oxygen mass flow and available shaft power proportional to air density at fixed volumetric efficiency; P/P0=rho/rho0. Breakpoints sample this analytic relation.

fuel_flow_kg_s.source: Original fictional fuel flow estimate against shaft-power fraction.
